title: Blue's Editable Nether Wart
description: When you harvest nether wart you will get blue's nether wart! It's editable too!
body: Now with this mod, when you break nether wart you will get 0-4 Blue Nether Wart per harvest! Look in gallery to see what the Blue Nether Wart looks like. The Blue Nether Wart gives 4 hunger points, and 6 saturation points. This is a simple mod, and will only be updated for new versions!
